strategy.overview: Cue Ball Wizard turns the ramp into a repeating Wheel-mode starter and builds a separate two-ball Multiball through the flashing solids or stripes and the 8-ball. Wheel rounds can run during that Multiball, which makes a Side Pocket round plus the three color-coded Jackpots the most useful stack.
strategy.simpleOverview: Shoot the lit ramp for the flashing Wheel round. For two-ball Multiball, clear the flashing solids or stripes, sink the 8-ball in the Side Pocket, then shoot the lit ramp.
strategy.summary: Use the lit ramp to start Wheel rounds, but build two-ball Multiball by clearing the flashing solids or stripes and sinking the 8-ball. When Side Pocket is the flashing Wheel award, start it and Multiball together, then use the cue ball to collect all three colored Jackpots.

quickInfo.name: Wagon Wheel
quickInfo.summary: The ramp starts the currently flashing round when lit. If it is dark, the Corner Pocket relights it.

quickInfo.name: Two-ball Multiball
quickInfo.summary: Clear the flashing solids or stripes, sink the 8-ball in the Side Pocket, then shoot the lit ramp.

quickInfo.name: Multiball Jackpots
quickInfo.summary: Knock the cue ball into each of the three colored target groups. After all three Jackpots, shoot the ramp for the Super Jackpot.

quickInfo.name: Pool Ball Mania
quickInfo.summary: Complete all five Wheel rounds to light the ramp for the three-ball switch frenzy. Its total is awarded after the balls drain, so a tilt loses it.

quickInfo.name: Nine Ball Play
quickInfo.summary: After Pool Ball Mania, shoot the temporarily lit ramp, clear solids 1–7, sink the 8-ball, then hit the timed 9 target.

steps.text: When the ramp's red lamps flash, shoot it to start the Wheel round shown above the flippers. If the ramp is dark, shoot the Corner Pocket to relight it.
For two-ball Multiball, clear whichever bank of solids or stripes is flashing, then hit the cue ball into the Side Pocket to light the ramp.
Wait for Side Pocket to be the flashing Wheel round when practical, then shoot the lit ramp to start the round and two-ball Multiball together.
During two-ball Multiball, use the cue ball to hit each of the three colored target groups for its Jackpot. Hit the drop targets between Jackpots to raise the remaining values.
After all three colored Jackpots are collected, shoot the ramp for the Super Jackpot. The sequence resets and can be repeated until one ball drains.
Continue completing the five different Wheel rounds. When Pool Ball Mania is lit, wait until two-ball Multiball has ended before starting it if you want the third ball to be served.

buildsToward.title: Pool Ball Mania and Nine Ball Play

steps.text: Complete Rowdy Ramp, Horseshoe Extra Ball, No Way, Spell Double, and Combo Shots from the Wheel.
Shoot the ramp for Pool Ball Mania. Keep the ball alive and avoid tilting, because its accumulated total is paid only after the balls drain.
After Pool Ball Mania, shoot the ramp while Nine Ball Play is lit, clear solids 1–7, sink the 8-ball, then hit the flashing 9 target before its timer expires.

machineSetup: Cue-ball hardware: Some machines have the physical cue ball removed. On those copies, the No Way target and two white Side Pocket targets replace the normal Jackpot contacts.
Difficulty: Hard settings lower some feature values. The shot order remains useful, but do not expect every printed value to match.

cautions.issue: Starting Pool Ball Mania during two-ball Multiball does not serve a third ball.
cautions.response: Finish two-ball Multiball first when the extra Pool Ball Mania ball matters more than starting immediately.

cautions.issue: A tilt forfeits the Pool Ball Mania total.
cautions.response: Settle the game after that mode instead of using an aggressive save that risks losing the entire accumulated award.
